_comment: Hand-identified functions of ffxiv.exe (the 2013 beta client), applied by Rhipper's ghidra/ApplyFacts.java after the RTTI names (rtti32.py), so these win. One entry per function: the name, and the evidence.

0x403aa0.name: WinMain
0x403aa0.evidence: ___tmainCRTStartup calls it as (0x400000, 0, its command-line pointer, STARTUPINFO.wShowWindow): hInstance, hPrevInstance, lpCmdLine, nShowCmd

0x420900.name: GetMyDocumentsPath
0x420900.evidence: SHGetMalloc, SHGetSpecialFolderLocation(0, 5 = CSIDL_PERSONAL), SHGetPathFromIDListW into its string argument, the item list freed through IMalloc::Free; its caller appends "/My Games/"
